submission.natural_language_explanation: A layer-0, purely token-level (retrospective) detector of rare formal/Latinate subword pieces rather than of meanings: block 0's MLP sees only the current token's post-LayerNorm embedding, so strength is a lookup on the surface form (token identity explains 96% of scan variance and position 0.1%; 85% of the attribution sits on the peak token, and sentence content or position moves a member's strength by only ~0.1-0.15 of max, e.g. ' control' 0.586 at position 1 down to 0.485 at position 81 and 0.72-0.85 across sentences), rising to 0.4-0.9 of max on the control/efficacy families - ' control'/' controls'/' controlled'/' controlling' 0.58-0.73, ' effective'/' effectively'/' efficiently'/' effectiveness' 0.51-0.70, ' regulate'/' regulates'/' regulating'/' regulation'/' deregulation' 0.59-0.69, ' succeeded'/' succeeding'/' successful'/' succeed'/' succeeds' 0.42-0.91, ' optimize'/' optimized'/' optimization'/' optimal' 0.34-0.53, plus ' eliminate(d)'/' elimination', ' cooperate'/' cooperation', ' abolish(ed)', ' supervise(d)'/' supervision', ' govern(s)'/' governed', ' authorize(d)'/' authorization', ' terminate(d)'/' termination', ' implement(s)'/' implemented', ' improve(d)'/' improvement', ' comply'/' compliance', ' license(d)', ' manage(s)', ' develop(ed)', ' integrate', ' establish'/' establishment', ' combat', ' conquer', ' dominate', ' eradicate', ' minimize'/' maximize'; and to 0.15-0.45 on year numerals 1970-2009, the month pieces ' Dec'/' December'/' Nov'/' Oct', capitalised abbreviations and word-initial fragments (' Comp', ' Reg', ' Ret', ' rec', ' pub', ' Acc', ' EC', ' NEC'), and technical or code stems (' neut', ' cellul', ' carcin', ' metast', ' electro', ' disinfect', ' fertiliz', ' init', ' util', ' func', ' struct'). Crucially it reads exactly 0.000 on the high-frequency band whatever the meaning - within the very same stems the common derived form is silent (' govern' 0.48 vs ' government' 0.0, ' authorize' 0.48 vs ' authority' 0.0, ' develop' 0.16 vs ' development' 0.0, ' manage' 0.18 vs ' management' 0.03, ' manager' 0.0, ' effect' 0.04 vs ' effective' 0.70, ' succeeding' 0.67 vs ' succession' 0.0, ' improvement' 0.35 vs ' improvements' 0.0) and so are the everyday Latinate institutional nouns (' policy', ' system', ' support', ' information', ' education', ' organization', ' performance', ' industry', ' technology', ' action', ' service', ' community', ' society', ' history', ' medical', ' cost', ' standards', ' procedures', ' assessment', ' enforcement', ' monitoring' all 0.000) - so predict active iff the token is one of the listed rare pieces, not iff the text is about control, regulation or efficacy: rare inflections the scan never listed still fire (' regulators' 0.21-0.32, ' ineffective' 0.25, ' cooperation' 0.25, ' succeeds' 0.42, ' optimize' 0.51, ' abolition' 0.08 is the family exception) while swapping a member for a common word in the same slot drops the peak to exactly zero.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The government announced new development plans, and management said the effect on the local economy would be modest.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same governance topic, but every candidate token is an explicitly silent high-frequency form ('government', 'development', 'management', 'effect'), so the token-lookup hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The authority approved the manager's succession plan after a long and unusually tense board meeting last spring.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Near-misses of the 'authorize', 'manage' and 'succeed' families in their common derived forms ('authority', 'manager', 'succession'), which the hypothesis lists at 0.0.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Several improvements to the building were completed last year, but the cost ran over the budget.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the explicitly stated split between 'improvement' (0.35) and the plural token 'improvements' (0.0), which the token-lookup hypothesis predicts is silent.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The effect of the drug was small, and the researchers cautioned that more work was needed.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The token 'effect' is explicitly listed at 0.04, so the hypothesis predicts silence despite the word being the root of the active 'effective' family.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The department released a new policy on information standards, and officials will review the system across the industry.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Regulatory-policy sentence built only from institutional nouns that the hypothesis lists at 0.000 ('policy', 'information', 'standards', 'system', 'industry'), so it predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Public support for the education system depends on how the community views the performance of each local service.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same public-services topic but only tokens from the explicitly silent institutional list ('support', 'education', 'system', 'community', 'performance', 'service').

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The organization collects information about cost and performance for its medical history project and shares it each year.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Health-organization vocabulary that prior-art semantic readings would fire on, but the hypothesis lists all of 'organization', 'information', 'cost', 'performance', 'medical' and 'history' at 0.000.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Their technology and industry groups funded research on safety standards and on enforcement procedures for the whole region.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Regulation-and-enforcement topic containing only silent listed nouns ('technology', 'industry', 'standards', 'enforcement', 'procedures'), so the token hypothesis predicts inactivity.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The society has a long history of action on community health and education policy, according to its annual report.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A further set of everyday Latinate institutional nouns ('society', 'history', 'action', 'community', 'education', 'policy') that the hypothesis says read exactly 0.000 whatever the meaning.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The committee's assessment of the monitoring program found that the procedures were followed in every case.
